textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
component("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01) local palette = include("ColourPalette") component:setColor(palette:getRGBFloats(palette.MONSTER_LEVEL_COLOUR)) component("font"):Set(game.getTitleFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.25*game.menuScaleX()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_RIGHT_ALIGNED)
if game.isTribalIsland() and game.monsterLevel(game.selectedMonsterId()) < 1 then component("text"):SetString(game.getLocalizedText("TRIBAL_INACTIVE")) else component("text"):SetString(game.getLocalizedText("LEVEL").." "..game.monsterLevel(game.selectedMonsterId())) end
component("layer"):SetString("ContextBar")
